}

# called at the end of the roll (DA_Hold_exploration_workaround): the charter has done its work
DA_HX_end_roll = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
	clr_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_scavengers
	clr_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_tunnelrats
	clr_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_blasters
	clr_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_gizmo
	owner = { if = { limit = { ai = no } DA_HX_refresh_ready_count = yes } }
}

# Country scope. How many holds could send a company now: the tooltip of the explore marker of the top bar.
# Also run on the monthly pulse for players (common/on_actions/DA_Attention_Markers_on_actions.txt).
DA_HX_refresh_ready_count = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_HX_ready_count value = 0 }
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { DA_HX_can_send = yes }
		owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_HX_ready_count value = 1 } }
	}
}

# The Send button. The company leaves now; the floor table rolls when the modifier of its way down has run out.
DA_HX_send = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_2 = yes } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_send_1 value = 1 } }

			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_send_2 value = 1 } }
			owner = { add_treasury = -40 }
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_send_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens } } }    # was else (else_lowering.py)
			
			owner = { add_treasury = -25 }
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_send_2 value = 0 } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_send_effect_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			DA_HX_end_roll = yes
			remove_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_send_2 value = 1 } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_send_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
				if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_send_2 value = 1 } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors

	if = {

# The country menu (DA_adk_hold_exploration_menu.1). The AI keeps the old pace; a player's company is the one chosen
# in the Dwarven Hall (DA_HX_hall_charter_<id>) and travels like any company of that charter. The floor is found the way
# DA_Hold_exploration_workaround finds it. The price is paid by the menu (DA_HX_hall_pay_<n>).
DA_HX_depart_from_menu = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { ai = no } NOT = { owner = { DA_GB_corps_owner = yes } } }
		DA_HX_end_roll = yes
		remove_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below
		if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_1_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_2 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_1 value = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_2 value = 1 } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
				if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_2 value = 1 } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_2 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
				if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_2 value = 1 } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}

				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			} } }

		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_has_dig_level_1_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_2 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {

				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_blasters } }
				set_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_blasters
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 28 }
			}

				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_gizmo } }

				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 102 }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_1 value = 1 } } NOT = { AND = { DA_has_dig_level_4_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_5 } } } }    # was else_if (else_lowering.py)
			if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_5_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_6 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_1 value = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_tunnelrats } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_blasters } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_gizmo } } }

			if = {

			if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_7_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_8 } } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_1 value = 1 } }

			}
		} } } } } } } } } }
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { which = DA_else_DA_HX_depart_from_menu_1 value = 0 } }
	}
	set_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress
}

# Country scope. What a departure of the country menu costs, deep by deep, and the line that says who goes (the AI
# never chooses a company: it pays the usual price, without the line).
DA_HX_hall_pay_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_corps_owner = yes ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_tunnelrats } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_blasters } NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_gizmo } }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_corps_go_2_scavengers
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_corps_owner = yes ai = no has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_tunnelrats }
		add_treasury = -30
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_corps_go_2_tunnelrats
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_corps_owner = yes ai = no has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_blasters }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_corps_go_2_blasters
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_corps_owner = yes ai = no has_country_flag = DA_GB_hall_corps_gizmo }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_corps_go_2_gizmo
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens }
		add_treasury = -40
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_wardens
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_prospectors
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_loreseekers
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ai = no }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_pathfinders
	}
	else = {
		add_treasury = -25
	}
}
